messages.author: 8793473c73ea423c
messages.subject: Install issues, R version 4.0.3
parts:
Hello, 

I have R version 4.0.3 and Mac OS Mojave version 10.14.5. I could install INLA without issue before I updated R to my current version, but now when I run either

install.packages("INLA",repos=c(getOption("repos"),INLA="https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable"), dep=TRUE)

or

install.packages("INLA",repos=c(getOption("repos"),INLA="https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/testing"), dep=TRUE)

I get the error (replacing "/testing" with "/stable" for the stable version command)

trying URL 'https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/testing/bin/macosx/contrib/4.0/INLA_20.12.10.tgz'
Content type 'application/x-tar' length 163804738 bytes (156.2 MB)
=====================================
downloaded 117.2 MB

Error in download.file(url, destfile, method, mode = "wb", ...) : 
  download from 'https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/testing/bin/macosx/contrib/4.0/INLA_20.12.10.tgz' failed

Can you advise? From other posts on this forum it looks like you updated the package to be compatible with this version of R. Is there a way to manually install through the command line?

Thanks,
Eva

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Install issues, R version 4.0.3
parts:
we're building on MacOS version 10.15 Catalina, so it might be that you have to upgrade the Mac (which is a good idea in any case...).

before that, can you quit R/rstudio, and do this manually? open a terminal and do

curl --output INLA_20.12.10.tgz https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/testing/bin/macosx/contrib/4.0/INLA_20.12.10.tgz
R CMD INSTALL ./INLA_20.12.10.tgz

and then see what happens.

let me know

Best
H
